acceptance: Retain first static failure and frozen v1. New fault tests verify output ambiguity/partial-frame behavior, not fabricate a complete transcript from a failed sink. No exception to source/authority/receipt acceptance gates.
rules: Complete canonical JSON plus one LF, zero exit, and matching external receipt bytes are all required for prepare success. A missing/truncated response is never success.

An output sink can fail after any prefix. The CLI must not append a second JSON stdout record after an emission attempt. On output failure emit a bounded diagnostic refusal to stderr where possible and exit nonzero; stdout completeness cannot be guaranteed when its sink fails.
After possible API execution, outside-API failures conservatively report workspace_may_exist=true. API WorkflowError flags retain their exact phase. No rollback or automatic retry.

Raw CLI path strings must already equal their absolute canonical Path spelling, with no parent traversal, NUL or overlength values. API Path values are already normalized objects and receive canonical-structure validation.
scope: Preexecution clarification of CLI sink failure; no product v1 executed, no golden bytes, API recovery, input validation, publication or success gate changed.
